head: claude/drain-performance-backlog-pass2
title: perf-backlog drain 2: retire the unmeasured-accrual-clock class (2 closed / 9 refused / 1 filed)
body:
## Denominator at base sha `68e73de8`

`docs/claude/performance-review-backlog.json` — **112 rows**, of which **44 unresolved**
(`open` 13, `kept_open` 31) and 68 resolved. Verified myself at my base sha, not taken from the brief;
it matches. `kept_open` outnumbered `open` **2.4×**, and that ratio turned out to be the finding.

## Burn-down

| | count |
|---|---|
| examined | 44 unresolved (all), 11 measured in depth |
| **CLOSED** | **2** |
| **REFUSED** | **9** (each with a stated reason; 7 materially advanced by measurement) |
| **FILED** | **1** |
| net unresolved | **44 → 43** |

## Reconciliation at head

```
BASE origin/main : 112 rows  {resolved 68, kept_open 31, open 13}
HEAD             : 113 rows  {resolved 70, kept_open 29, open 14}
LOST (in base, not head): NONE
ADDED: PB-20260902-SPLG-TREND-LONG-1D-IS-CANDLE-STARVED-AND-CANNOT-SIGNAL
STATUS CHANGES:
   PB-20260618-015:                 kept_open -> resolved
   PB-20260707-SPLG-IAUM-PROMOTION: kept_open -> resolved
unresolved before: 44   after: 43
```

No row was lost and none was silently added. The file's serialisation was round-tripped through
`backlog_append.detect_format` (`indent=2, ensure_ascii=False`, no trailing newline) on every edit, so the
diff is **+40/-5 style lines**, not a 21k-line reformat.

---

## Was there a real class? Yes — and it is why `kept_open` is 2.4× `open`

### THE UNMEASURED ACCRUAL CLOCK

Eleven rows in this file say some version of *"revisit when >= N closed trades accrue on leg L."*
`check_backlog_criteria`'s existing guard accepts that as a perfectly good exit condition — and it **is**
one, *only if the clock runs*. Nothing had ever measured whether it does.

I measured all eleven against the live journal (trader serving sha `68e73de8`, `restart_pending: false`).
**Not one was in the state its own text implies.**

| | rows | what is actually true |
|---|---|---|
| **Clock RAN, nobody looked** | 5 | **375 closed trades** had accrued behind rows that read "waiting". `PB-20260706-ETH-BOOK-RECHECK` wanted ≥20 and has **76**; `SRQ-20260728-M27-WINNERS-SHIP` has **133** in 36 days |
| **Clock STOPPED** | 4 | `eth_pullback_prop_2h` and `htf_pullback_trend_2h` are `execution: shadow` — the declared no-order gate. `tqqq_trend_long_1d` and `splg_trend_long_1d` have **zero rows in `trades`, ever** |
| Clock running, thin | 2 | measured and stated |

An accrual threshold on a leg that does not trade is a **permanent resident wearing a field** — the
`BL-20260825-KEPT-OPEN-ROWS-WITH-NO-EXIT-CONDITION-CAN-NEVER-BE-RETIRED` failure one level down, where the
exit condition is *present and vacuous* rather than absent, which is strictly harder to spot by reading.

### What retires it

The half that matters is checkable **offline**. Whether a leg *has* accrued needs the live journal; whether
it **can** accrue is a pure read of `config/strategies.yaml` + `config/accounts.yaml`.

- **`scripts/ops/accrual_clock.py`** — five clock states, never collapsed: `can_run` / `gated_shadow` /
  `gated_disabled` / `not_routed` / `absent_from_config`. `--all` is the standing census; `--self-test`
  asserts every one of the five is reachable (a state nothing can produce is a state nobody can rely on).
- **an accrual-clock arm on `check_backlog_criteria.py`** — a row entering `open`/`kept_open` with an
  accrual-shaped exit condition must name its legs in `accrual_legs`, and every leg must resolve `can_run`.
  Diff-scoped and grandfathered like its two siblings, and it **announces** rather than silently skipping
  when config is unreadable.
- Both registered in `run_guards.py` (blocking self-test + advisory census).

It demands a **structured field**, not prose. A guard that scraped strategy names out of criteria text
would be cheaper to fool than to satisfy — rename the leg in the sentence and it goes quiet while the row
stays dead. That is this module's own `new-table-wiring-guard` lesson.

**The tool immediately earned its keep, against me.** Its first run on the real corpus flagged
`slv_trend_1h` as `gated_shadow` — which I had just written up as one of six healthy filling cells. See
*Caveats*.

### Positive control (the guard is shown to FAIL, then green again)

Four rows planted into the backlog, guard run against `origin/main`:

```
PLANT-A-NO-LEGS      accrual criterion, no accrual_legs        -> FLAGGED
PLANT-B-SHADOW-LEG   accrual_legs ["htf_pullback_trend_2h"]    -> FLAGGED  gated_shadow
PLANT-C-ABSENT-LEG   accrual_legs ["no_such_leg_at_all"]       -> FLAGGED  absent_from_config
PLANT-D-GOOD         accrual_legs ["ict_scalp_sol_5m"]         -> not flagged   <- negative control
GUARD EXIT CODE = 1
```

Restored: `git diff` on the backlog **empty** (byte-identical), guard exit `0`. `PLANT-D` is what stops
this being a guard that merely fails at everything.

**Full guard suite after committing: `PASS 70 · FAIL 0 · SKIP 0`.** `pytest` and `lint-imports` were both
absent from this sandbox (the two "tooling" failures the brief warned about); I `pip install`ed both and
re-ran rather than deferring, so `artifact-validity-guard`, `operator-owed-guard` and `layer-guard` are
genuinely green, not assumed. Two guards I broke and fixed rather than weakened: `ruff` (unused import) and
`impossibility-claim-guard`, which correctly demanded that "this leg cannot produce a trade" name what
checked it — all 12 annotated blocks now do.

---

## Closures

### 1. `PB-20260618-015` (high) — real-money read of `eth_pullback_2h` on `bybit_2`

Criterion, verbatim: *"A recorded real-money read ... closed-trade count, win rate, pnl WITH its provenance
coverage, and the ADX-gate rejection count from the audit log over the SAME window. State the population.
**This closes on the review being recorded.**"*

**Population:** `trade_journal.db::trades` via `/api/bot/db/table/trades?filter_col=strategy_name&...`,
`filter_state == "applied"` asserted; `status='closed'`, falsy `is_backtest`, `account_id='bybit_2'`;
whole lifetime of the cell, `2026-06-24T04:01Z → 2026-08-28T16:25Z`. Trader sha `68e73de8`.

**Measured (a):** 14 closed rows, 13 with non-null `pnl` (the 14th is a deliberately-deferred
`intent_reduce_executed`). Win rate **0.3846** (5W/8L), sum **−14.3979 USD**. Provenance via
`src.runtime.provenance.split_counts/coverage` — the canonical predicate, not a hand-rolled one —
**9 MEASURED / 4 ESTIMATED / 0 FABRICATED / 0 UNVERIFIED, `pnlCoverage 0.6923`**. Restricted to the 9
MEASURED rows: **−14.062**, win rate 0.3333. *The loss survives restriction to broker truth.*

**Measured (b):** `adx_min: 25` is set; the refusal string is
`"Strategy 'X': ADX {v} < adx_min {n} — regime filter, non-actionable."` Counted on
`trade_journal.db::signals`: **2,649 lifetime**, **2,368 inside the same window** (located by bisecting the
ordered result on `logged_at_utc`), against 43,370 total `eth_pullback_2h` signal rows — the gate refuses
~6.1% of evaluations. **It is firing, not merely configured.**

**Denominator checked, not assumed:** the dual-write's earliest row overall is `2026-05-02` and its earliest
`eth_pullback_2h` row is `2026-06-11` — both *before* the window opens — so the first in-window rejection at
`2026-06-25T08:05Z` is a real first-rejection, not a log-start artifact.

### 2. `PB-20260707-SPLG-IAUM-PROMOTION` — closed as *deferred with reason*

Criterion offers two limbs: *"paper soak reviewed; Tier-3 promotion PR proposed **or deferred with
reason**."* I reviewed the soak live. **There is no soak.**

**Population:** same route and assertions, `account_id='alpaca_paper'`, 57 days since filing.
`splg_trend_long_1d`: **zero rows in `trades`** — not zero closes, zero rows, including zero rejections.
`iaum_pullback_1d`: 12 rows, **1 closed**, 11 refusals. Promotion deferred; the question is answered.

**And the reason is a datable regression, which is worth more than the closure.** `splg_trend_long_1d` has
4,736 `signals` rows, of which **3,660** read
`"need at least 46 candles for the donchian(30) / atr(14) windows; got 18."` Its oldest 500-row page
(`2026-07-08 → 07-14`) is 100% ordinary `"no breakout on the latest bar"`; the newest is 100% starvation;
onset `2026-07-23T13:30:34Z`. A **fleet-wide** `LIKE '%need at least%candles%'` sweep of the entire
`signals` table returns 3,660 rows and **every one is `splg_trend_long_1d`** — run fleet-wide precisely so
the negative has a denominator. Filed as `PB-20260902-SPLG-TREND-LONG-1D-IS-CANDLE-STARVED-AND-CANNOT-SIGNAL`.

---

## Refusals (9) — reason each

| row | why not closed |
|---|---|
| `PB-20260620-001` | Conjunctive, and **neither hard clause is reachable from here**. The *fills* half is answered (51 closed `alpaca_paper` rows across the six cells). "Bracket fill" needs Alpaca broker truth and **there is no `/api/diag/alpaca_open_orders`** analogue to the `ib_`/`bybit_` routes — refused for a **missing access surface**, named. `exit_reason` cannot substitute: 36 `exchange_flat_reconciled` / 11 `sl_cross` / 3 watchdog / 1 giveback, zero bracket labels — and `BL-20260822-EXIT-ATTRIBUTION-UNDER-REPORTS-BRACKET-HITS` says that label under-reports bracket hits, so this is evidence the *label* cannot answer, **not** that no bracket filled |
| `PB-20260821-R-AND-DOLLARS-DISAGREE-IN-SIGN` | Conjunctive; clause 1 now holds, clause 2 fails. Real money 30d, n=30 (clears its own ≥20 bar), `rCoverage 1.0000`: `totalPnl +25.4214` vs `totalR +46.8871` — **signs match**. But `ict_scalp_sol_15m` reports `expectancyR 206.920` over 18 paper trades against −$2,064. **And the aggregate agreeing hides a live defect**: per-leg on *real money*, `ict_scalp_5m` still reads `+26.02R` against **−$6.59**. Closing on the aggregate would report a fixed defect that is still live |
| `PB-20260821-SLV-TREND-1H-ZERO-WINS-IN-13` | Needs an M7 packet **and** an operator decision for each of four legs; I produced neither. Advanced: two of the four are **already in shadow** (attributed through git — `slv_trend_1h` `2026-08-24` `6f7c14f8`, `htf_pullback_trend_2h` `2026-08-23` `9544ced3`) |
| `PB-20260625-001` | Waits for ≥10-20 closed **prop** ETH trades on a leg that is `execution: shadow` with 32,606 signal rows and **five** journal rows in its life, **zero** closed on `breakout_1`. Not waiting on accrual — waiting on a **Tier-3 decision**, restated as such |
| `PRB-20260716-HTF-CROSSBOOK-NEG` | Same leg, same gate, no close anywhere since `2026-08-10`. Both limbs (`>45% over ≥15 fresh` / `<25% → KILL`) are unevaluable. Tier-3 |
| `PB-20260630-001` | Same shadow gate; 2 `bybit_2` closes in 64 days. Its *substance* (June-7 reconciliation contamination) stays true and worth carrying; the accrual framing does not |
| `PB-20260630-002` | **Gates open, threshold ~40 months away** — a *different* failure from the shadow rows and deliberately not conflated. Both legs healthy (5,333 signal rows each, ordinary "no breakout"), but 0 and 1 journal rows in 64 days. Neither limb reachable: the soak did not diverge, **it did not happen**. Corroborates the operator's 2026-08-11 correction already on the row |
| `PB-20260611-M15-2` | 28 `bybit_1` closes accrued. Its operator correction already says accrual was never the blocker; both now agree from opposite directions. The named backtest is still unrun |
| `PB-20260622-002` | Clock running but thin (14 rows / 72 days), and the row names **no number** for its "live + out-of-sample evidence", so no threshold can be tested. Stated rather than re-deferred |

---

## Caveats — OBSERVED vs INFERRED

**OBSERVED** (measured this session, live, population stated):
- Every count above: `trades` and `signals` row counts, win rates, PnL sums, provenance splits, ADX
  rejection counts, entry-minute histograms, signal reason strings and their date bounds.
- `filter_state == "applied"` asserted on **every** DB-explorer call. My first attempt used
  `filter_col=strategy` — the route **ignores it silently** and returned `total: 5324` = the whole table
  (`BL-20260813-DB-EXPLORER-SILENTLY-IGNORES-UNKNOWN-FILTER-COLUMN`, hit and caught here). The column is
  `strategy_name`.
- `execution:` / `enabled:` / routing read from committed config at `68e73de8`; the two shadow flips
  attributed to specific commits by walking `git log` over `config/strategies.yaml` after
  `git fetch --deepen`.
- The guard's failure on planted defects and its green after restore.

**INFERRED, and flagged as such in the rows themselves:**
- **That the two shadow demotions were caused by `PB-20260821`.** Both postdate it and match its proposal,
  but **neither commit cites the row id**. Recorded as plausible, not credited — the mistake CLAUDE.md's
  `PROTECTION_REASSERT_MODE` note exists to warn against.
- **Why SPLG gets only 18 candles.** Not opened; that is the filed row's job.
- **Whether the scattered `alpaca_paper` entry minutes are mid-bar entries.** `trades.timestamp` is the
  journal-row time and can lag the signal; separating the two needs an `order_packages` join I did not do.

**A correction I made to my own work, recorded in the row:** my first draft of the `PB-20260620-001`
verdict said *"all six cells produce fills"*. `accrual_clock.py --all` then flagged `slv_trend_1h` as
`gated_shadow` (flipped `2026-08-24`, last close `2026-08-25`). True of the history, **false as a statement
about the sleeve now** — five of six can fill, one cannot. That is the row's own hazard in miniature: a
count over a window during which the generator was switched off is not a rate. The same error had already
bitten me on `PRB-20260716`, where a rate extrapolation gave a reassuring *"~1.4 months to threshold"* on a
leg that had been shadow-gated for 23 days.

**Explicitly refuted, as the brief asked:** no row in this file asks to harmonise `pnlCoverage` with
`totalPnlMeasured`. Nine rows mention the fields; all nine use them correctly as the different populations
they are (MEASURED-only vs MEASURED+ESTIMATED). Nothing to refute.

**Scope:** one backlog file plus the guard/tool the class retirement required. No sibling backlog, no
`OPEN-ITEMS.json`, no `config/`, no `ROADMAP.md`, no order-path or Tier-3 file touched. I did **not**
register in `docs/claude/session-board.json` — that would breach the one-file scope, and the live board
(#6927) carries the authoritative claim, posted before my first substantive call.

---

## FOR THE MANAGER

1. **This is a DRAFT. I have not enabled auto-merge.** All 70 guards pass on committed work.
2. **Two things need a decision that is not mine.**
   - **`splg_trend_long_1d` is dead and reads as live.** Enabled, `execution: live`, routed, and unable to
     signal for 41 days. It is the second instance this week of *declared-live, structurally cannot trade*
     (`PB-20260902-MGC-TREND-1H`, filed by another session). Two instances with different mechanisms is a
     class forming, and nothing on any config or `/api/bot/strategies` surface distinguishes such a leg
     from one that simply sees no setups.
   - **`ict_scalp_5m` reports `+26.02R` against `−$6.59` on real money, 30d, n=14.** The fleet aggregate
     signs agree only because `trend_donchian_eth_4h` outweighs it. If anyone is about to close
     `PB-20260821-R-AND-DOLLARS-DISAGREE-IN-SIGN` on the aggregate, that is the thing to stop.
3. **Five rows are DUE, not waiting** — 375 closed trades sit behind them. `PB-20260706-ETH-BOOK-RECHECK`
   (76, snoozed to a date a month past), `PB-20260721-ICTSCALP-ALTCOIN` (87), `SRQ-20260728-M27-WINNERS-SHIP`
   (133, 4 of 6 legs complete), `PB-20260611-M15-2` (28), `PB-20260620-001` (51). Each now carries the
   measurement and a sharpened `next_action`; a review session can act on them without re-deriving anything.
4. **One access gap blocks a row and is cheap to close:** there is no `/api/diag/alpaca_open_orders` to
   match the `ib_` and `bybit_` routes, so Alpaca bracket state is unreachable read-only. That is the
   smallest thing that would unblock `PB-20260620-001`.
5. **Worth relaying to a health-review session** (out of my scope to file there): the splg candle
   starvation is arguably a data-feed defect as much as a strategy one.
6. **Honest accounting:** 2 closed against 1 filed, net −1 unresolved. The class retirement is the real
   output — 9 of the 11 accrual rows now carry a measured clock and a truthful exit condition instead of an
   unfalsifiable one, and no future accrual row can be filed without one.
